profile.headline: Software engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 18 years of experience in front-end and back-end development.
Specializes in large-scale systems for financial institutions and government agencies.
Proficient in modernizing existing applications and leading new development projects
from inception to implementation. Demonstrated expertise in agile methodologies,
delivering high-quality solutions within tight deadlines.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Consistently met project deadlines by effectively managing time and prioritizing
tasks according to importance.
Analyzed proposed technical solutions based on customer requirements.
Developed scalable and maintainable code, ensuring long-term stability of the
software.
Developed reusable components that significantly reduced development effort on
multiple projects.
Enhanced user experience with intuitive interface design and responsive web
applications.
Designed REST calls using React to streamline user interface performance.
Maintained high-level expertise in React state management strategies.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to develop seamless integration of APIs improving data flow within applications.
Investigated new technologies like Docker or Kubernetes to streamline
deployment processes while maintaining a consistent dev/prod environment.
Improved application performance by optimizing Python code and implementing
best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Python (Programming Language) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provided frontend support for government file management system utilizing ReactHooks and MaterialUI.
Implemented API calls via GraphQL and axios.
Provided expert input in grooming and planning meetings to aid in proper agile development.
Supported Devops in UI specific deployment configurations.
Responsible for demoing all completed functionality in details to stakeholders at the end of each sprint.
Responsible for creating unit test for newly developed components with no less than 100% coverage. 
Collaborated with teammates on complex designs via peer programming and technical expertise support.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · React Hooks · Redux.js · Material-UI · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Java · JavaScript · jQuery · SQL · Python (Programming Language) · PL/SQL · Semantic HTML · Bootstrap (Framework) · Spring Boot · Spring Batch · Hibernate · PostgreSQL · Jira · Eclipse · Atom · Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain high-quality software products supporting Department of Defense (DoD) standards and infrastructure, using Microsoft SQL and integrated system components.
Support and comply with documented software process and procedure requirements spanning all phases of software product lifecycle.
Translate detailed designs into executable software.
Produce software documentation and update existing documentation to include detailed software design documents and unit/composite test cases based upon stakeholder requirements and use cases.
Collaborate with other team members and participate in code reviews.
Manage tasks, time, and priorities in accordance with aggressive development deadlines, client expectations, and quality/delivery models including Agile Scrum and SDLC best practices.
Perform unit and integration testing on work items in line with Scrum cycles.
Work and collaborate with Program Management and other team members to proactively assess and validate solution efficiency and integrity against defined performance criteria.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Java · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · SQL · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · jQuery UI

positions.title: Jr. Consultant
positions.description:
Provided frontend support for nautical inventory management system.
Participating in SDLC task to provide efficient coding practices.
Designing mockups and documentation for well-organized development
Modernizing a critical system impacting future programming and budgeting.
Contributing to the design and development of a new feature set and other cloud enabled modernizations.
Responsible for coding, testing, and debugging feature components according to client provided design specifications.
Contributions are made at various levels of the application stack including front end UI development via react/redux and backend/API development via Java Spring Boot
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaScript · React.js · AngularJS · Spring Boot

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to design and development of client and server web applications.
Create applications that mirror popular social media sites for the government.
Built RESTful web services for United States Army to store user data using Spring Framwork, Hibernate and MySQL.
Provide front and backend support for existing applications.
Designed Web pages using jQuery and Backbone. Maintained and updated HTML/CSS 
Provided technical support to other web design team members as directed.
Provided real-time support for large scale applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Newport News, Virginia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Analyze, design, code and document complex applications for large-scale IT systems.
Contributed software engineering expertise in the development of products through the software lifecycle, from requirements definition through successful deployment.
Help to determine customer requirements for the final program or system.
Analyzes problems in terms of such factors as user requirements, input data, and output data 
Assess and recommend methods of improving efficiency of existing programs and systems
Create custom Java code and JavaScript to perform business logic to be integrated within a COTS product.
Utilized HL7v3 to communicate between a user management system and provisioning service

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Adapted existing methods and procedures to create possible alternative solutions to moderately complex problems. 
Understood the strategic direction set by senior management as it relates to team goals.
Used considerable judgment to determine solution and sought out guidance on complex problems. 
Determined methods and procedures on new assignments with guidance.
Utilized and understands Software development life cycle and development languages, frameworks and platforms
Created innovative applications to utilize groundbreaking technology such as Google Glass.
Developed programs to be used by financial institutions within a Windows and Unix/Linux environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaScript · Google Glass · Spring Boot · Spring MVC · Subversion
